Complete transcripts are saved to the selected folder and linked to Text history, even when internal automatic saving is off. Existing text retention and pinning apply. Deleting a transcript also deletes its managed Markdown files.

New recordings and kept imports use this destination. Existing items retain their own locations. These files follow audio history retention and deletion. If the folder is unavailable, useful private input is preserved for retry.
